list.name: pc_id
list.label: PC
list.query: SELECT pc_id FROM pc_info ORDER BY pc_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT cpu_percent AS cpu, gpu_percent AS gpu, mem_percent AS mem FROM metrics_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT collected_at AS time, cpu_percent AS "CPU", mem_percent AS "MEM", gpu_percent AS "GPU" FROM metrics_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT collected_at AS time, vram_mb AS "VRAM(MB)", disk_read_mb AS "Disk Read(MB)", disk_write_mb AS "Disk Write(MB)" FROM metrics_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at
SELECT collected_at AS time, inbound_mb AS "Inbound(MB)", outbound_mb AS "Outbound(MB)" FROM metrics_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT (scores->'risk_vector'->>'mining')::float AS mining, (scores->'risk_vector'->>'network_abuse')::float AS network_abuse, (scores->'risk_vector'->>'threat')::float AS threat, (scores->'risk_vector'->>'aging')::float AS aging, (scores->'risk_vector'->>'malfunction')::float AS malfunction, scores->'risk_vector'->>'primary_type' AS primary_type FROM anomaly_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (scores->'score_breakdown'->>'resource')::float AS resource, (scores->'score_breakdown'->>'network')::float AS network, (scores->'score_breakdown'->>'process')::float AS process, (scores->'score_breakdown'->>'episode')::float AS episode, (scores->'score_breakdown'->>'correlation')::float AS correlation, (scores->'score_breakdown'->>'ml')::float AS ml, (scores->>'final')::float AS final FROM anomaly_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT detected_at, severity, anomaly_type, COALESCE((scores->'score_breakdown'->>'final')::float, (scores->>'final')::float, (scores->>'total')::float, 0) AS anomaly_score FROM anomaly_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' AND $__timeFilter(detected_at) ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Top 프로세스 ($pc_id, 최근 스냅샷)
panels.description: metrics_history.extra->'top_processes' 가 존재할 때만 표시. 부재 시 빈 결과.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT extra FROM metrics_history WHERE pc_id = '$pc_id' AND extra ? 'top_processes' ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT (proc->>'name')::text AS process, (proc->>'cpu_percent')::float AS cpu, (proc->>'mem_percent')::float AS mem FROM latest, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(latest.extra->'top_processes') AS proc ORDER BY cpu DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT a.anomaly_type AS verdict, a.severity AS severity, (a.scores->>'final')::float AS score, a.scores->'risk_vector'->>'primary_type' AS primary_type, a.scores->'evidence_meta'->>'fast_path_match' AS fast_path, a.scores->'evidence_meta'->'active_signals' AS active_signals, a.scores->'signal_quality'->>'overall' AS signal_quality, a.scores->'signal_quality'->'sources' AS sq_sources, a.scores->'explanation_confidence'->>'level' AS explanation_confidence, a.scores->'explanation_confidence'->'reasons' AS expl_reasons, j.is_mock AS is_mock, j.details->>'reason' AS reason, j.details->>'action' AS action, j.details->>'benign_confidence' AS benign_confidence, j.details->>'contradicting_mining_evidence' AS contradicting_evidence, to_char(a.detected_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS judged_at FROM anomaly_history a LEFT JOIN ai_judgment_history j ON j.anomaly_id = a.id WHERE a.pc_id = '$pc_id' ORDER BY a.detected_at DESC LIMIT 1
